title: From Judgment to Interference: Early Stopping LLM Harmful Outputs via Streaming Content Monitoring
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the safety and harmlessness of LLM outputs using datasets like PKU-SafeRLHF, which explicitly evaluate categories of 'Social bias' and 'Immoral' content. By measuring whether outputs adhere to these moral and social standards, the paper contains a component evaluating ethics and morality in language models.
